API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIDNS Control PolicyFirewall DNS Rules Resource Update Firewall DNS Rule
Firewall DNS Rules Resource Update Firewall DNS Rule
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/firewallDnsRules/:ruleId

Updates the DNS Control policy rule information based on the specified ID. To learn more about the rule configuration, see Configuring the DNS Control Policy.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ruleId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the rule

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
action
string
REQUIRED

The action configured for the rule that must take place if the traffic matches the rule criteria, such as allowing, blocking, or redirecting the traffic.

Possible values: [ALLOW, BLOCK, REDIR_REQ, REDIR_RES, REDIR_ZPA, REDIR_REQ_DOH, REDIR_REQ_KEEP_SENDER, REDIR_REQ_TCP, REDIR_REQ_UDP, BLOCK_WITH_RESPONSE]

capturePCAP
boolean

A Boolean value that indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not

blockResponseCode
string

When the action is selected as BLOCK_WITH_RESPONSE to block the DNS traffic and send a response code to the client, specify the response code using this field.

Possible values: [FORMERR, SERVFAIL, NXDOMAIN, NOTIMP, REFUSED]

accessControl
string

The admin’s access privilege to this rule based on the assigned role

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

id
int32

Unique identifier generated for the rule

name
string
REQUIRED

The name of the DNS Control rule

order
int32
REQUIRED

Policy rules are evaluated in ascending numerical order (Rule 1 before Rule 2, and so on), and this field specifies the order of execution for the rule.

rank
int32
REQUIRED

The admin rank specified for the rule based on your assigned admin rank. Admin rank determines the rule order that can be specified for the rule. Admin rank can be configured if it is enabled in the Advanced Settings. .

description
string

The description of the rule

locations
object[]
locationGroups
object[]
groups
object[]
departments
object[]
users
object[]
protocols
string[]

The protocols to which the rules applies

Possible values: [ANY_RULE, SMRULEF_CASCADING_ALLOWED, TCP_RULE, UDP_RULE, DOHTTPS_RULE]

state
string

The state of the rule indicating whether it is enabled or disabled

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

timeWindows
object[]
srcIps
string[]

Source IP addresses or FQDNs to which the rule applies. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IP address. Each IP entry can be a single IP address, CIDR (e.g., 10.10.33.0/24), or an IP range (e.g., 10.10.33.1-10.10.33.10).

srcIpGroups
object[]
srcIpv6Groups
object[]
destAddresses
string[]

Destination IP addresses or FQDNs to which the rule applies. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific destination IP address. Each IP entry can be a single IP address, CIDR (e.g., 10.10.33.0/24), or an IP range (e.g., 10.10.33.1-10.10.33.10).

destIpGroups
object[]
destIpv6Groups
object[]
destCountries
string[]

SCHEMA
action
string
REQUIRED

The action configured for the rule that must take place if the traffic matches the rule criteria, such as allowing, blocking, or redirecting the traffic.

Possible values: [ALLOW, BLOCK, REDIR_REQ, REDIR_RES, REDIR_ZPA, REDIR_REQ_DOH, REDIR_REQ_KEEP_SENDER, REDIR_REQ_TCP, REDIR_REQ_UDP, BLOCK_WITH_RESPONSE]

capturePCAP
boolean

A Boolean value that indicates whether packet capture (PCAP) is enabled or not

blockResponseCode
string

When the action is selected as BLOCK_WITH_RESPONSE to block the DNS traffic and send a response code to the client, specify the response code using this field.

Possible values: [FORMERR, SERVFAIL, NXDOMAIN, NOTIMP, REFUSED]

accessControl
string

The admin’s access privilege to this rule based on the assigned role

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

id
int32

Unique identifier generated for the rule

name
string
REQUIRED

The name of the DNS Control rule

order
int32
REQUIRED

Policy rules are evaluated in ascending numerical order (Rule 1 before Rule 2, and so on), and this field specifies the order of execution for the rule.

rank
int32
REQUIRED

The admin rank specified for the rule based on your assigned admin rank. Admin rank determines the rule order that can be specified for the rule. Admin rank can be configured if it is enabled in the Advanced Settings. .

description
string

The description of the rule
